description: This file defines the OTPSecondScreen widget, a Flutter StatefulWidget responsible for rendering an OTP entry interface. It includes a header, OTP input field, a continue button, debug options like skip OTP, and handling for OTP verification and bypass during testing.

classes.name: OTPSecondScreen
classes.description: A StatefulWidget representing the OTP verification screen, primarily for user input and verification of OTP codes, with debugging features such as bypassing OTP for testing purposes.

classes.name: _OTPSecondScreenState
classes.description: The internal state class managing OTP input, verification process, UI state updates, and debug bypass logic.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Disposes of the OTP input controller when the widget is removed from the widget tree.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the UI for OTP entry, including header, input field, continue button, and skip OTP debug button.

methods.name: _onContinueTap
methods.description: Handles tap event on Continue button, with logic to detect triple tap for OTP bypass.

methods.name: _bypassOTPForTesting
methods.description: For debugging/testing, sets login preferences and navigates directly to home screen, bypassing actual OTP verification.

methods.name: _verifyOTP
methods.description: Simulates OTP verification, updates login preferences, and navigates to home screen upon success.
